{{Infobox character|name=Roderick Ashbourne|image=Portrait roderick.jpg|house=[[House Ashbourne]]|role=Head of house|age=~52|kin=[[Kael Ashbourne]], [[Isolde Ashbourne]] (children)}}
'''Roderick Ashbourne''' was once the realm's most feared rider — his name won battles before they began. He rode twelve [[The Leap|Leaps]] and came home from all of them, and has carved more names into the Wall of Names than any living person.

He no longer carves names himself; younger hands do it. He begins sentences with the old certainty and trails off mid-thought, and when doubt takes him he dismounts — the realm's most feared rider walking, leading his horse by the rein across his own courtyard. The young read it as humility.

{{Quote|I rode twelve Leaps. Don't ask me how many I should have let pass.|Roderick Ashbourne, to his weapon-master}}
